description: Add the 108 columns across 44 tables that INSERT statements name but the live schema lacks; split the Network Canvas out of simulation_results and relax the constraints that outlive their owning shape (swp-scan-01)
irreversible_reason: Purely additive: it adds columns, relaxes two NOT NULLs and creates one unique index. A down.py would have to DROP 108 columns, destroying any data written since the migration ran, to undo a change that is harmless to leave in place. Re-running up() is a no-op, so roll-forward is the supported recovery path.
